newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Natural Gas analyses Kapuni gas decision.
newsitem.headline: Natural Gas analyses Kapuni gas decision.

text.p: Natural Gas Corp said on Tuesday it was analysing a judgement from the Auckland High Court, issued on Monday, in respect to the dispute over the Kapuni gas contracts.
It said it was reserving any decision on possible future actions until the analysis was complete.
The dispute is between the Kapuni Mining Companies (Shell and Todd) on the one hand, and Kapuni Gas Contracts (a wholly owned subsidiary of Fletcher Energy ) and Natural Gas Corp on the other.
In essence, the Court held that:
1) The Kapuni Gas Contract continues for the life of the field and all the gas is dedicated to the buyer under contract.

2) The contract lessens competition in the gas market pursuant to section 27 of the Commerce Act. The Court ordered that from April 1 the remainder of the gas in the Kapuni field be divided equally between the plaintiffs and the defendants in the case.
3) There had been no breach by Natural Gas Corp of section 36 of the Commerce Act.
